assets.name: Game Animation Sample
assets.source: Epic Games Launcher: Unreal Engine > Samples > Game Animation Sample > Create Project
assets.licence: Epic sample content, usable in Unreal Engine projects
assets.installedTo: game/Content/ (Audio, Blueprints, Characters, Input, IsolatedExamples, Levels, MetaHumans, Misc, Movies, Widgets), with game/Config/*.ini and its plugins in Rim3D.uproject
assets.usedFor: character locomotion (motion matching) and the Stage 0 character test
assets.reinstall: Create the sample at C:\Dev\GameAnimationSample, then copy its Content folder over game/Content

assets.name: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 plugin for Unreal Engine 5.8 (DLSS, StreamlineNGXCommon, StreamlineCore, StreamlineDLSSG, StreamlineReflex)
assets.source: https://developer.nvidia.com/rtx/dlss (UE 5.8 plugin, 2026.10.16_ue5.8_dlss4.5plugin_v8.9.0.zip, about 1.2 GB)
assets.licence: NVIDIA RTX SDK EULA (free, may ship in games)
assets.installedTo: game/Plugins/DLSS, StreamlineNGXCommon, StreamlineCore, StreamlineDLSSG, StreamlineReflex (not in Git); enabled in game/Rim3D.uproject; the PC keeps the zip in C:\Dev\Rim3D-dlss
assets.usedFor: DLSS upscaling, DLAA, ray reconstruction and frame generation (docs/design/graphics-options.md)
assets.reinstall: Download the zip from the page above, unpack it and copy those five folders from its Plugins folder into game/Plugins

assets.name: ImGui (Unreal plugin by VesCodes, bundling Dear ImGui 1.92.8)
assets.source: https://github.com/VesCodes/ImGui, commit 71f29cf675b7d501af4f8e152fb73145f24a3f58
assets.licence: MIT (plugin and Dear ImGui)
assets.installedTo: game/Plugins/ImGui/ (not in Git); enabled in game/Rim3D.uproject, used by the Rim3D module (Rim3D.Build.cs)
assets.usedFor: the overseer's inspect panel and speed controls (U6), later the architect menu and colony panels (U7, U8)
assets.reinstall: git clone https://github.com/VesCodes/ImGui.git game/Plugins/ImGui, then git -C game/Plugins/ImGui checkout 71f29cf675b7d501af4f8e152fb73145f24a3f58

assets.name: Pawn looks (generated)
assets.source: Made by the PawnLooks commandlet from the Game Animation Sample's Kellan and the MetaHuman body type DNA files in the engine's MetaHumanCharacter plugin
assets.licence: Derived from Epic sample content and engine content, usable in Unreal Engine projects
assets.installedTo: game/Content/Rim3D/Generated/PawnLooks/ (not in Git)
assets.usedFor: body shape morphs on Kellan's body and clothes, our skin material, horns (docs/design/looks.md)
assets.reinstall: "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe" game\Rim3D.uproject -run=PawnLooks -unattended -nosplash -nullrhi

assets.name: Pawn faces, hair and marks (generated)
assets.source: Made by the PawnFaces commandlet from the engine's MetaHuman Creator plugin (MetaHumanCharacter: its face model and preset faces, and the grooms listed in assets/pawn_faces.json) and the Game Animation Sample's Kellan; tattoo, scar and body hair masks drawn in code
assets.licence: Derived from engine and Epic sample content, usable in Unreal Engine projects; the masks are our own
assets.installedTo: game/Content/Rim3D/Generated/PawnFaces/ (about 660 MB, not in Git); the plugin is enabled for the editor only in game/Rim3D.uproject
assets.usedFor: seeded face shapes, eye colours, hair styles, beards and eyebrows, tattoos, scars and body hair; V2b: face skins (colour and normal maps synthesized offline by the plugin's texture synthesis model from the presets listed under skins in assets/pawn_faces.json) the bare skin material, and hair cards for far pawns (each hair groom's own card meshes and coverage texture, copied) (docs/design/looks.md)
assets.reinstall: "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe" game\Rim3D.uproject -run=PawnFaces -unattended -nosplash -nullrhi (after PawnLooks)

assets.name: Building ghost material (generated)
assets.source: Made by the BuildingMaterials commandlet: our own unlit translucent material with a Color (through the inverse of the camera exposure since L1) and an Opacity, marked for instanced static meshes
assets.licence: Our own
assets.installedTo: game/Content/Rim3D/Generated/Buildings/M_BuildingGhost.uasset (not in Git)
assets.usedFor: blueprints and the whole-building ghost behind frames (docs/design/building-draw.md)
assets.reinstall: "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe" game\Rim3D.uproject -run=BuildingMaterials -unattended -nosplash -nullrhi

assets.name: Wound decal material (generated)
assets.source: Made by the FightMaterials commandlet: our own deferred decal with a Color and an Opacity that blends a round soft-edged blob into what it lands on
assets.licence: Our own
assets.installedTo: game/Content/Rim3D/Generated/Fights/M_WoundDecal.uasset (not in Git)
assets.usedFor: wounds on bodies and blood on the ground (docs/design/fights.md)
assets.reinstall: "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe" game\Rim3D.uproject -run=FightMaterials -unattended -nosplash -nullrhi

assets.name: Terrain textures (Poly Haven)
assets.source: https://polyhaven.com (and https://ambientcg.com if a layer says so), layers listed in assets/terrain_textures.json, 1k JPG colour and DirectX normal maps downloaded by tools/terrain_textures.py
assets.licence: CC0 (public domain)
assets.installedTo: files in game/Content/ThirdParty/TerrainTextures/ and the made textures and material (M_Terrain, MI_Terrain) in game/Content/Rim3D/Generated/Terrain/ (neither in Git)
assets.usedFor: the ground, sand, gravel and rock of the runtime terrain (docs/design/terrain.md); Megascans can replace them by setting a layer to "local" in the list. Since U13 the material has a Wetness input (the rain makes the ground dark and shiny, docs/design/sky.md): run the commandlet again after pulling U13, or the ground just stays dry
assets.reinstall: python tools/terrain_textures.py, then "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe" C:\Dev\Rim3D\game\Rim3D.uproject -run=TerrainMaterials -unattended -nosplash -AllowCommandletRendering

assets.licence: CC0 (public domain)
assets.installedTo: files in game/Content/ThirdParty/StuffTextures/ and the made textures and materials (M_Surface, MI_Surface_<surface>) in game/Content/Rim3D/Generated/Surfaces/ (neither in Git)

assets.reinstall: python tools/stuff_textures.py, then "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe" C:\Dev\Rim3D\game\Rim3D.uproject -run=SurfaceMaterials -unattended -nosplash -AllowCommandletRendering

assets.source: Poly Haven Fishermans Hat (https://polyhaven.com/a/fishermans_hat), 1k glTF downloaded by tools/clothes_art.py; garments are copies of the PawnLooks hoodie and cargo trousers; tuque and helmet made in code. Listed in assets/clothes_art.json

assets.name: Free sounds and music (V21)
